d: Namaa Partners has started an operating performance project with a corporate group in Saudi Arabia and is hiring a Data Analyst in the Kingdom for it and for the engagements that follow. You will turn client data on sales, costs, staffing and operations into clean tables, dashboards and short findings that our consultants take to management. The job is full-time and remote, from home anywhere in Saudi Arabia. The rest of the team works from Oklahoma City, eight to nine hours behind Riyadh, so expect some calls at the end of your working day.
Collect extracts from clients' finance, HR and operations systems and check them for gaps and errors
Clean, join and reshape the data in Excel, SQL or Python so business units and years can be compared
Build Power BI dashboards that show the performance measures agreed for each engagement
Write short notes that explain what changed in the numbers and why
Record every source, assumption and adjustment so the work can be checked
q: A bachelor's in statistics, mathematics, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field
Excel, including pivot tables and XLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH
Basic SQL: SELECT queries with joins and aggregations
At least one dashboard you built, at university, in an internship or at work
Tableau, or the Microsoft PL-300 Power BI certificate
Medical insurance for you and your family
Twenty-five days of paid annual leave, plus Saudi public holidays
End-of-service award under the Saudi Labor Law
A yearly budget for courses and professional certificates
Laptop and home office equipment, provided by Namaa
Namaa Partners is a management consulting firm based in Oklahoma City. We advise corporate groups, family enterprises and their boards on strategy, governance and operating performance.

d: Design, deploy, and manage servers, storage, virtualization, and network environments (on-premises and cloud).
Monitor system performance, capacity, and availability to ensure optimal uptime.

Configure and troubleshoot LAN/WAN, firewalls, load balancers, VPN, and routing protocols.
Collaborate with security teams to implement best practices, including patching, access control, and compliance standards.
Implement and manage backup solutions, replication, and disaster recovery procedures.

Work closely with applications, DBA, and support teams to deliver reliable IT services.

Other duties assigned within the scope of the job.

Strong understanding of networking concepts, including VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, and load balancing.
Skilled in storage, backup, and disaster recovery solutions ensuring business continuity.
Experience with monitoring tools and automation (PowerShell, Bash, Ansible).
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills with a focus on high availability and security.
Effective communicator and team player with the ability to work in fast-paced environments.

d: Specialty areas: Operating room, Recovery, Anesthesia, Clinics, Endoscopy, CSSD

We are seeking experienced Registered Nurses to deliver safe, compassionate, patient-centered care in a hospital and ambulatory surgery center in Dubai. Positions are available across the specialty areas listed above. Each nurse will be assigned according to relevant experience, demonstrated competencies, and service requirements; experience in all six areas is not required.
Reporting to: Head Nurse / Nurse Manager of the assigned department.
q: Valid, active Registered Nurse license authorizing practice in Dubai under the regulator applicable to the employing facility, including the Dubai Health Authority (DHA) where applicable. An eligibility letter alone does not meet this vacancy requirement.
Minimum of 5 years of post-registration clinical nursing experience, with demonstrated recent experience and competence in the specialty applied for.
Recognized nursing qualification acceptable to the applicable licensing authority.

Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification; Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) and other life-support certifications as required for the assigned specialty, patient population, and facility policy.
Strong clinical assessment, communication, teamwork, and electronic documentation skills, with proficiency in professional English.
Commitment to patient safety, confidentiality, infection prevention, and culturally respectful care.
The five-year experience threshold and specialty certification requirements above are recruitment criteria for these positions, not a statement of the regulator's minimum licensing requirements.
Assess nursing needs, develop and implement individualized care plans, evaluate outcomes, and promptly escalate deterioration or concerns.
Administer prescribed medications and treatments within authorized scope, verified competence, and facility policies; maintain accurate medication records.
Apply patient identification, allergy checks, infection prevention, safe handling, and procedure-verification processes relevant to the assignment.
Maintain complete, timely clinical records and provide structured handovers to support continuity of care.
Educate patients and families about preparation, treatment, recovery, follow-up, and warning signs appropriate to their care.
Collaborate with physicians, anesthesia teams, nurses, and support departments to coordinate safe care, transfers, and discharge.
Report incidents and near misses; participate in audits, quality improvement, competency assessment, and continuing professional development.
Maintain equipment readiness and appropriate stock levels, and follow approved emergency-response procedures.
Perform scrub and/or circulating duties according to verified competence; prepare the theatre, sterile instruments, supplies, and equipment for scheduled procedures.
Support surgical safety checks, aseptic practice, safe positioning, instrument and swab counts, specimen handling, and documented transfer to Recovery.
Receive structured postoperative handover and assess airway, breathing, circulation, consciousness, pain, nausea, and the surgical site; recognize and escalate complications promptly.
Deliver prescribed postoperative care and document recovery progress. Coordinate transfer or discharge only when approved criteria and required clinical authorization are met.
Provide nursing support to the anesthesiologist before, during, and after anesthesia, including patient preparation, monitoring, and readiness of relevant supplies and emergency equipment.
Assist with airway-related care and prescribed treatments only within documented competence, authorized scope, and required supervision; provide clear handover to Recovery.
Scope clarification: This is an anesthesia-support Registered Nurse role, not an independent nurse anesthetist position. It does not authorize independent administration of anesthesia.
Conduct nursing assessments and observations, identify urgent concerns, and assist physicians with consultations, examinations, and minor procedures within the assigned clinic.
Provide prescribed treatments, wound care, patient education, and follow-up coordination; maintain consultation-room readiness and accurate outpatient records.
Prepare patients and procedure rooms, verify completion of required pre-procedure checks, and assist with diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopy within assessed competence.

Support patient monitoring and recovery according to the assigned role and sedation policy; manage specimens and maintain endoscope handling, reprocessing, and traceability records according to approved procedures and manufacturer instructions.

Support safe receipt, decontamination, inspection, assembly, packaging, sterilization, storage, and distribution of reusable instruments and devices, according to assigned duties and validated competencies.

Maintain segregation of clean and contaminated workflows, instrument traceability, cycle and quality-control records, and stock availability; escalate failed indicators or processing deviations and withhold affected items under approved procedures.

Role-specific requirement: CSSD applicants must demonstrate relevant sterile-processing experience and documented competency. RN licensure does not replace any additional qualification, authorization, or competency required for assigned sterile-processing duties.
Work only within the applicable nursing scope of practice, facility authorization, and demonstrated specialty competencies.
Maintain an active license and required certifications throughout employment.
Participate in scheduled shifts, weekends, public holidays, and on-call coverage where required by the assigned service.
Protect patient dignity, privacy, and confidentiality, and communicate respectfully with patients, families, and colleagues.

Applicants should submit an updated CV identifying the specialty applied for, evidence of a valid Dubai nursing license, nursing qualification, employment certificates confirming at least 5 years of clinical experience, and current life-support and relevant specialty certificates. Include availability to join and professional references.
